purpose: Stream processing pipeline that consumes network logs, classifies them, and builds a queryable graph database for email security analytics.

stack.runtime: Kubernetes (27 consumer deployments + API + FlightSQL + classifier)

groups.label: Ingestion
groups.description: Raw log discovery, parsing, and Kafka message production

groups.label: Graph Engine
groups.description: Entity extraction, Kafka consumers, DuckDB storage, derived computation

groups.label: Serving Layer
groups.description: REST API, FlightSQL, MCP server, and client SDK

groups.label: External
groups.description: Infrastructure services and external data sources

nodes.name: Graph Engine

nodes.name: Serving Layer

nodes.name: Message Producer
nodes.description: Scans NFS rawLog directories for slots, parses email messages, produces Kafka events

nodes.name: Entity Extraction
nodes.description: Consumes raw messages from Kafka, extracts entities (URIs, emails, IPs, domains, text, images) and publishes to entity-specific topics

nodes.name: Metadata Archiver
nodes.description: Archives raw email metadata and headers to DuckDB for historical reference

nodes.name: Domain Consumer
nodes.description: Processes domain entities, triggers DNS/WHOIS/HTTP enrichment, writes to domain.duckdb

items.title: Swallowed exceptions in enrichment
items.description: 10+ bare except Exception: pass/return False in enrichment and store code

nodes.name: Domain Enrichment
nodes.description: Multi-stage enrichment: WHOIS lookup, DNS resolution, UCLT probing, Certificate Transparency, HTTP reachability

nodes.name: URI Consumer
nodes.description: Processes URI entities with template extraction and path decomposition

nodes.name: URI Download
nodes.description: Downloads and classifies URI content, extracts signals. Includes JS rendering via headless browser

nodes.name: Subnet Consumer
nodes.description: Processes IP subnet entities with ASN lookups

nodes.name: Host Consumer
nodes.description: Processes hostname entities, resolves DNS records

nodes.name: Email Address Consumer
nodes.description: Processes email address entities extracted from message headers and bodies

nodes.name: Text Consumer
nodes.description: Processes text content entities extracted from email bodies

nodes.name: Image Consumer
nodes.description: Processes image entities extracted from emails and URI downloads

nodes.name: Content Template Consumer
nodes.description: Processes content template entities for structural similarity grouping

nodes.name: Cluster Consumer
nodes.description: Processes MinHash-based message clusters for campaign detection

nodes.name: Message Consumer
nodes.description: Collects per-message metadata and writes to message.duckdb

nodes.name: Edge: Emailed-With
nodes.description: Builds co-occurrence edges between entities that appear in the same email (259M+ rows)

nodes.name: Edge: Association
nodes.description: Builds structural association edges (DNS, SPF, resolve_to, landing_of)

nodes.name: Edge: Cluster Member
nodes.description: Connects messages to their MinHash clusters

nodes.name: Message Role Consumer
nodes.description: Tracks per-message entity roles (MailFrom, HeaderFrom, ReplyTo, Recipient, SPF auth)

nodes.name: Score Consumer
nodes.description: Ingests external reputation scores (Spamhaus, etc.) into external_score.duckdb

nodes.name: SPF Auth Consumer
nodes.description: Processes SPF authentication results for sender verification

nodes.name: Derived Refresh
nodes.description: Round-robin batch engine computing materialized views across 7 tiers (A-G) with configurable refresh intervals

nodes.name: Retention Scheduler
nodes.description: Daily cronjob (02:00 UTC) that runs retention policies on all entity and edge DuckDB files

nodes.name: REST API
nodes.description: FastAPI application with 15 routers: node lookup, search, ranking, subgraph, export, webhooks, health, metrics

endpoints.description: Look up entity by type and key

items.title: SQL string interpolation
items.description: API routers construct SQL via f-strings with hand-rolled _escape() instead of parameterized queries

items.title: Zero test coverage
items.description: Entire API layer has no tests — user-facing endpoints are untested

items.title: Arbitrary SQL debug endpoint
items.description: /debug/query executes user-supplied SQL — critical security risk

nodes.name: EdgePool
nodes.description: Direct DuckDB connection pool over 20+ snapshot files for fast point lookups (bypasses FlightSQL for latency-critical paths)

nodes.name: Pipeline Sentinel
nodes.description: Background health monitor: checks all 27 consumers, enrichment services, storage systems. Exports pipeline_status Prometheus gauges

items.title: God object (1256 lines)
items.description: Probing, evaluation, composite scoring, and main loop all in one file

nodes.name: Dashboard Stats
nodes.description: Background thread collecting aggregated stats for Grafana dashboards

nodes.name: FlightSQL Server
nodes.description: Arrow Flight SQL endpoint on gRPC:8815 for high-throughput analytical queries. Attaches all snapshots + release DBs

items.title: No authentication
items.description: FlightSQL server relies on network isolation only — no auth mechanism

nodes.name: MCP Server
nodes.description: Model Context Protocol server exposing graph database as tools for LLM agents

items.title: No auth tokens sent
items.description: MCP server proxies to REST API without authentication — will get 401 in production

nodes.name: Client SDK + CLI
nodes.description: Python library and CLI for querying GraphDB via REST API. Commands: search, node, subgraph, top, export, messages, stream, cache

items.title: Duplicated client package
items.description: Entire client duplicated between client/ and graphdb/client/ — copies have diverged

nodes.name: Spam Classifier
nodes.description: LightGBM regression model producing logbd.ml scores (-1 to +1) per entity type. 9 entity types trained independently

nodes.name: Weighted Sum Scorer
nodes.description: Heuristic weighted average of 16 normalized signals producing logbd.ws scores (0 to 1). Domain only

nodes.name: Verdict Merger
nodes.description: Combines 70% ML + 30% heuristic into final logbd verdict score

nodes.name: Infrastructure Classifier
nodes.description: LightGBM multiclass model identifying entity roles: regular, ESP, cloud, CDN, hosting. Suppresses infra entities from spam scoring

nodes.name: Dataset Pipeline
nodes.description: Exports entity views with graduated labels, builds train/test splits as Parquet

nodes.name: Classifier Scheduler
nodes.description: Orchestrates full classification pipeline: infra -> dataset -> train -> infer -> verdict -> release

items.title: No readiness/liveness probes
items.description: Classifier scheduler has no K8s health probes configured

nodes.name: Kafka (KRaft)
nodes.description: Single-broker KRaft cluster handling 29 topics with retention-based compaction

items.title: Single broker, no replication
items.description: KRaft single broker with replication factor 1. Loss halts entire ingestion pipeline

resilience.fallback: Pipeline halts; query serving continues from existing data

nodes.name: Schema Registry
nodes.description: Confluent Schema Registry for Avro serialization of entity messages

nodes.name: MinIO
nodes.description: S3-compatible object store for Parquet snapshots of all DuckDB databases

items.title: Single replica, no HA
items.description: MinIO runs as single replica. Snapshot reads/writes fail if pod dies

nodes.name: Redis
nodes.description: Deduplication, enrichment result queues, SPF auth cache. No persistence

items.title: No manifest in repo
items.description: Redis referenced everywhere but no K8s manifest — externally managed with unknown HA

nodes.name: NFS (rawLog)
nodes.description: Network-attached storage at /mnt/nfs/rawLog containing raw email log files organized by day

nodes.name: Longhorn Storage
nodes.description: Distributed block storage providing ~1,090Gi across 18 PVCs with XFS formatting and 2 replicas

nodes.name: Prometheus
nodes.description: Metrics collection. Scrapes 40+ metrics from all consumers and API

nodes.name: Loki
nodes.description: Log aggregation. All services emit structured JSON logs via structlog

nodes.name: Grafana
nodes.description: Dashboard visualization. 5 provisioned dashboards: overview, operational-health, classifier, cluster-detail, uri-template-detail

nodes.name: Spamhaus / External Scores
nodes.description: External reputation data sources providing ground-truth labels for training

nodes.name: Log Server
nodes.description: Upstream email gateway producing rawLog files to NFS

nodes.name: Security Analyst
nodes.description: Human analyst querying the graph via CLI, API, or MCP for email threat investigation

nodes.name: LLM Agent
nodes.description: AI agent using MCP tools to investigate graph entities

data_flows.name: Log Ingestion Pipeline
data_flows.description: The primary write path from raw email logs to structured Kafka events
data_flows.trigger: New rawLog files appear on NFS from the log server

steps.action: Parses email metadata using multiprocess pool
Extracts URIs, emails, IPs, text, images from messages
Buffers domain entities, flushes to DuckDB
Enriches with WHOIS, DNS, HTTP reachability

data_flows.name: Derived Computation Pipeline
data_flows.description: Batch computation of materialized views across 7 tiers of increasing complexity
data_flows.trigger: Continuous round-robin refresh (Tier A every 5min, Tier G every 6h)

steps.action: Selects batch of stalest entities from base DuckDB
Computes tier A (traffic aggregation) through tier G (graph algorithms)
Exports Parquet snapshots to MinIO for read path

data_flows.name: ML Classification Pipeline
data_flows.description: Trains and runs spam + infrastructure classifiers, merges into final verdict

steps.action: Seeds from known infrastructure lists, trains LightGBM multiclass
Exports entity views with graduated labels to Parquet
Trains LightGBM regression on labeled entities
Computes heuristic weighted average of 16 signals

data_flows.name: Entity Investigation
data_flows.description: Analyst queries the graph to investigate a suspicious domain
data_flows.trigger: Security analyst runs CLI command or API call

steps.action: Sends lookup request for domain entity
Queries EdgePool for fast point lookup

failure_modes.trigger: Kafka broker becomes unreachable (single point of failure)

cascade.effect: Consumer poll fails, entity pipeline halts
All node consumers stop receiving events
No new data to process, staleness increases

failure_modes.impact: Complete ingestion halt. Query serving continues from existing data via DuckDB snapshots. No new entities enter the graph.
recovery: Kafka replays from last committed offset
No data loss if Kafka storage intact
failure_modes.name: Kafka broker becomes unreachable (single point of failure)

failure_modes.trigger: MinIO pod dies or storage becomes unavailable

cascade.effect: Cannot open Parquet views, new connections fail
EdgePool refresh fails, stale data served
Snapshot export fails, read path goes stale

failure_modes.impact: FlightSQL becomes unavailable for new queries. API serves increasingly stale data. Classifier training fails.
recovery: Snapshots regenerate on next derived-refresh cycle
failure_modes.name: MinIO pod dies or storage becomes unavailable

failure_modes.trigger: Multiple processes attempt concurrent write access to same DuckDB file

cascade.effect: Retry with exponential backoff (up to 5 attempts)

failure_modes.impact: Temporary processing delays. Data eventually consistent after retry succeeds.
recovery: Automatic retry with backoff and jitter
failure_modes.name: Multiple processes attempt concurrent write access to same DuckDB file

failure_modes.trigger: Domain enrichment overwhelms consumer buffer (>80% capacity)

cascade.effect: Switches to catchup mode: skip enrichment, fast-stage only

failure_modes.impact: Domains enter graph without enrichment data. Enrichment backfilled asynchronously once pressure subsides.
recovery: Automatic: consumer resumes enrichment when buffer drops below threshold
failure_modes.name: Domain enrichment overwhelms consumer buffer (>80% capacity)

cascade.effect: Inventory scan returns empty, no new slots processed

failure_modes.impact: Ingestion halts at source. All downstream consumers run out of work. Existing graph data unaffected.
recovery: Automatic: message-producer retries on next scan cycle when NFS recovers
failure_modes.name: NFS mount at /mnt/nfs/rawLog becomes unavailable
